records.reason: A two-action movement activity (roll down an incline, slowed 2 on later turns, 4d6 on impact) resolved entirely at the table; nothing changes on the sheet.
A reaction that cancels a misfortune effect on a roll; it is resolved at roll time and grants no sheet value.
An impulse whose effects land on enemies and allies in an area (saves vs your class DC, temp HP to allies); nothing modifies the caster's own statistics.
Adds a save-or-stupefied rider to the TARGET of Twin Feint; it changes only the target's condition state.
A polymorph that swaps you to your eidolon's already-tracked statistics for the duration; the app has both blocks, and the substitution is a table-time transformation with no new numeric field.
A two-action activity making two Strikes and making the target off-guard against the second; an action resolved at the table.
Doubles the DURATION of Unleash Psyche only; durations of the unleash-psyche toggle are tracked at the table, not as a modifier.
A triggered reaction Strike/Disarm; an action resolved at the table.
A two-action activity making two Strikes that can knock the target prone; only the target's state changes.
An Interact that splits an imbued one-handed ikon into two twin-trait halves treated as a single ikon; a physical/equipment manipulation with no change to the character's statistics.
A one-action activity making two Strikes against hunted prey; combining damage for resistances is resolved when the GM applies damage.
A two-action activity that adds the Exploit Vulnerability damage to a Strike against that target; resolved at the table against a specific creature.
Lets you roll Performance instead of Acrobatics for Tumble Through; the sheet lists both skill modifiers and the player picks which to roll — no modifier changes.
A two-action activity (Tumble Through with Performance, then a fan Strike); an action resolved at the table.
A finisher that ignores the range-increment penalty for one thrown Strike and returns the weapon; resolved at attack time against a specific range.
Lets an item-activated Heal be cast as Harm instead; a cast-time choice on an item's spell, changing no statistic.
A one-action follow-up dealing persistent bleed to the target; only the target's condition changes.
Pure narrative/roleplay identity switch adjudicated by the GM (what you may say under truth-compelling effects).
A one-action press activity making two Strikes; an action resolved at the table.
A one-action flourish making two Strikes; an action resolved at the table.

Raises the inventor's daily temporary-gadget count by 2 (repeatable at 14th for +4 total) — a per-day player resource. Nothing in src models gadgets at all: there is no 'gadgets' entry in src/rules/classResources.ts, so resourceMaxSet has no resourceId to target, and no advancedAlchemy-style count field exists for Gadget Specialist.

Doubles the free daily prepared snares from Snare Specialist (4/6/8 by Crafting rank becomes 8/12/16). The app already computes that allowance in src/rules/snareFormulas.ts snareAllowance(), but the number is hardcoded off Crafting rank with no record field able to modify it.
Extends the mortal-weakness benefit of Exploit Vulnerability to allies' Strikes; it changes only allies' damage, never your own sheet.
Adds a mercy type that returns a dead creature to life via Lay on Hands; the whole effect lands on another creature.

Makes EVERY spell in the bard's repertoire a signature spell, which drives the app's 'cast at' heightening picker. The engine only produces all-repertoire signatures from the summoner class feature check ('unlimited-signature-spells', src/rules/build.ts:1766-1771); there is no record field a feat can set, and no entry exists for this feat.
Ignores difficult/greater difficult/hazardous terrain and movement-triggered traps; terrain and hazards are map state the app does not model.
A one-action Strike that leaves the TARGET off-guard and clumsy; only the target's conditions change.
On your critical hits the TARGET becomes off-guard against your attacks; it changes only the target's state.
A finisher whose only effect is making the target off-guard; the target's state changes, not yours.
A mythic reaction (Stride twice, become the target of the triggering Strike, possible counter-Strike) resolved entirely at the table.

Upgrades the frequency of Accidental Shot from once per day to once per hour. The granting feat already carries limitedUses {max:1, per:'day'} in core.json, so the usesUpgrade lane applies and this feat carries no field.
Lets you spend a Mythic Point to attempt certain social checks at mythic proficiency; a per-roll spend resolved at the table, not a standing modifier.
Grants an extra save to avoid gaining the controlled condition; a roll-time save with no bonus or standing statistic (the record's save DC text is even truncated in the source).
Improves how far you can Leap without an Athletics check; jump distance is not a tracked statistic (it is not a Speed) and is resolved at the table.

Grants the Unwavering Resilience reaction, an action resolved at the table (+1 circumstance on a triggering save, temp HP on a crit success); the action record exists in core.json and the feat already links it via descRefs.

Modifies the character's own megafauna companion: auto-success on recovery checks, death at dying 5 instead of 4, and one free dying reset per day. The companion-mod registry (COMPANION_MODS in src/rules/companionGrants.ts) has no entry for it; there is no dying field for companions, so a note-only mod is the delivery, matching the existing note-only precedent ('stealthy-companion').

companionMod.note: Unbreakable Bond: your megafauna companion automatically succeeds at the recovery check to stabilize at 0 HP on its turn, and it dies at dying 5 rather than dying 4. Once per day, the first time it would reach dying 5 and die while you're alive, its dying value drops to 0 instead.

records.reason: 'You gain 20 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 10' is a flat +10 to maximum HP over the Unbreakable Goblin heritage's 10 (heritage record confirms 10). The feat carries no field; maxHpBonus is the existing feat-level HP lane consumed by src/rules/build.ts:3177 and deriveMaxHp (Toughness, Thick Hide Mask). Falling damage and the Bouncy Goblin rider stay table-resolved.

A fortune reaction rerolling a failed Will save; a roll-time reroll, and its once-per-10-minutes frequency is not expressible by limitedUses (per accepts only day|hour|minute|round|turn) — writing 'per minute' would over-grant.

'Ignore the reduction to your Speed from any armor you wear' plus a 5-foot reduction to one other Speed penalty. The app really does subtract the worn armor's Speed penalty from every Speed (src/rules/derive.ts:1926) and applies encumbered as -10, with no check for this feat and no record field that waives a penalty (speedPenalty only ADDS one; landSpeedBonus would over-grant when unarmored).

Grants motion sense as an imprecise sense out to 30 feet — a real sense grant with no field on the record. The senses field takes named senses with range/acuity and already carries non-core names in core.json (spiritsense, wavesense, magicsense, echolocation, deathsense), so it expresses this exactly.
Raises a wielded shield's Hardness by 5 only against damage dealt by undead; hardness is not a modifiable target kind and the conditional applies when the GM resolves damage to the shield.

Changes the character's own animal companion or familiar: it gains the undead trait instead of animal and gains void healing. No COMPANION_MODS entry exists in src/rules/companionGrants.ts; void healing is not an IWR line, so a note-only mod delivers it (precedent: 'stealthy-companion').

companionMod.note: Undead Companion: your companion has the undead trait instead of the animal trait and gains void healing (void damage heals it; vitality damage harms it). It otherwise uses the normal animal companion or familiar rules and can still be affected by conditions and effects most undead ignore.

records.reason: Lets you use Diplomacy on mindless undead; a GM-adjudicated expansion of who a skill action can target, with no modifier.
A two-action Sneak-then-Strike activity with a -2 on the Stealth check; an activity resolved at the table, with a penalty that applies only to that one roll.
Removes the off-guard condition and weapon penalties while fighting in water; underwater combat is an environmental circumstance the GM applies at the table, not a sheet value.
You stabilize immediately when dropped to 0 HP by non-silver damage; dying/stabilization handling at 0 HP is resolved at the table.
Grants temporary Hit Points equal to your level only when the Orc Ferocity reaction triggers; temp HP is entered on the play sheet when it happens, not a standing maximum.
Adds a frightened rider to the TARGETS of your Sleep spell; it changes only the targets' conditions.
Ignores range-increment penalties and downgrades the target's cover; both are attack-time circumstances against a specific distance and target, not sheet values.

Upgrades degrees of success (success to critical success on Escape and on saves vs grabbed/immobilized/restrained, and worsens a foe's Grapple failure); a roll-time degree-of-success change with no bonus, and the sheet has no roll to modify.
Lets Arcana substitute for Nature/Occultism/Religion on magic-related checks and removes the usual Arcana penalty; the sheet lists all four skill modifiers and the player chooses which to roll.
Improves the movement your ALLY gets from Liberating Step; it never touches your own statistics.
A Mythic Point spend granting Recall Knowledge answers and a one-off initiative roll at mythic proficiency; both are resolved at the table for a specific encounter.
A two-action area attack dealing void damage with a save; all effects land on creatures in the area.
Expands the emanation of an archetype state by 5 feet for its duration and makes a Demoralize attempt; emanation radius is a map effect and Demoralize targets a creature.
A triggered free action to Demoralize without the auditory trait or the language penalty; it affects the target and is resolved at the table.

An activity combining Shove/Trip with a ranged Strike at a shared multiple attack penalty; it is a one-off activity's own MAP handling, not a standing mapReduction (the feat grants no lower general penalty).
Halves the time to Decipher Writing and waives the retry penalty; an exploration/downtime activity with timing the app does not model.
Lets Rapid Assessment attempt up to four Recall Knowledge checks; the number of checks in an activity is resolved at the table with unchanged modifiers.
A mythic reaction: spend a Mythic Point to attempt the triggering save at mythic proficiency and counter-Strike; a per-roll spend resolved at the table.
